description: This figure presents a collection of 2D molecular structure drawings for organophosphorus and related ligands used as extractants in T-LLE for REE separation, including TBP, Cyanex 272, D2EHPA, EHEHPA, TOPO, DCH18C6, Aliquat 336, and others. Each structure is labeled with its common name and chemical abbreviation. No axes, scales, or quantitative data are present; the figure is a chemical structure reference panel that cannot be encoded as tabular data.
